<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex87032023-03-0314-03-48" status="reviewed"> 
         <milestone unit="section" n="223.232.212.111.A11 gzhan gyi phyogs brjod pa"/>
         re zhig phyogs snga ma dgod pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">blo gros chen po dag</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note>
         <note type="editorial">A parallel presentation of this position is found, but in a shorter version, in gTsang nag pa (ID:3839)'s bsDus pa (ID:4549) 92b8-93b3; gTsang nag pa does not identify its author, but says only "slob dpon dag".</note> 'di skad du 'chad de | rtags chos can gyi phyogs cig la ma grub pa phyogs chos kyi skyon ma yin pa dang | rtags kyi phyogs cig chos can la ma grub pa mi srid pa dang | de gnyis mi mtshungs pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
